title: Where money comes from and goes
summary: Money comes in from pocket money, gifts or wages, and goes out on things we buy.

variants.markdown:
**English draft for R5 review.**

Money **comes in** from places like pocket money, gifts or wages. It **goes out** when we buy things or pay bills. Knowing both sides is the first step to deciding what to do with it. Gullak uses virtual play money only.

questions.prompt: Which of these is money coming in?
questions.explanation: Pocket money is money coming in; buying a snack is money going out.
Paying a bill means money leaves your hands.
